criteria.rule: All eleven motions produce their named artifact and a decision gate, or explicitly explain a justified route back; no silent next-stage execution.

Each receiver uses only the previous handoff without inventing approved choices. From stage 6 onward, selected concept and hypothesis survive; from stage 8 onward the narrative survives; from stage 10 to 11 the experiment and decision rule survive. Missing required context must produce a visible gap, not hidden invention. For this full-chain case, a dropped required item is a failure even if the receiver honestly flags it.
No actual interviews, plant data, measured benefits, prices or market figures are fabricated. Synthetic status and UNKNOWN quantities survive the chain.
Recommendations are not recorded as approved before the scripted participant reply. Later approvals are identified as scripted teaching decisions.
The final Learning Review reports NOT RUN for the real experiment and cannot claim customer or operational validation.
